title: Japanese Stew with Nourishing Seaweed
description: A hearty and nutritious Japanese stew made with nourishing seaweed, perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped vegetables and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the nourishing seaweed, poppy seeds, seeds, and soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Pour in the rice vinegar and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Enjoy as a hearty and nutritious meal.
